text:
deploy-bot: auto-rollback suppressed for release v3.7.1 (canary slice). reason=metric-noise-detection. embed-failure-rate spike 10m window: 3.2% (threshold 2.0%). suggestion=hold traffic to v3.7.1 partial slice and human review. /cc @maya @omar :warning:

maya: seeing this now. did deploy-bot also flag latency?

deploy-bot: latency stable p95 ~ 220ms, small increase but within SLOs. primary anomaly metric=embed_failure_rate.

omar: thanks. can we get log sample and a stacktrace we can grep? pinging lucy to check model-serving side.

lucy: on it. quick sanity: rolling back quant-opt kernel on canary would be fastest if we decide. any non-embedded traffic impacted?

anita: support reporting ~6 customer errors in last 8m for embeddings calls, two on dedicated customers. customers complaining about 503s in payload. raising ticket INF-3421.

ben: from product: we need to weigh auto-rollback benefit vs flare false-positives. current release notes already out. if we pin older version we should notify customers in #customer-notify.

maya: propose manual hold for 30m while we validate logs and sample traces. if embed_failure_rate stays >2% after triage, escalate to partial rollback.

ci-bot: run tests: `// quick smoke`

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST'
```

lucy: grep shows errors from tokenizer shard on gpu-2: `TokenizationError: invalid byte sequence` in ~40% of failing requests. looks like an input-corner-case but should have been caught earlier.

omar: interesting — could be upstream client sending unexpected encoding. anita, any customer payloads?

anita: two of the six reported payloads attached to ticket. attaching sanitized payloads now. both have non-utf8 bytes in metadata field. customer SDKs usually normalize but maybe we missed an edge.

b en: (typo)

maya: ok — if failures are from bad client payloads, rolling back probably won't help. plan: 1) pin v3.7.1 traffic slice to prevent auto-failover; 2) send quick note to support to ask customers for sanitized payloads and mitigation; 3) keep canary paused for 30m and re-evaluate.

lucy: how to pin? can someone run the pin command?

omar: I can. command: `rbctl pin-release --env=prod --slice=canary --version=3.7.0 --duration=60m`

maya: please do the pin and paste confirmation here. include rollback playbook link.

omar: running now...

ci-bot: triggered workflow `pin-release` by omar at 1754321205

omar: done — traffic slice pinned to 3.7.0 for 60m. confirmation id=pin-1754321205.

maya: thanks. anita, draft a short line for customers: we are investigating embedding errors and may ask for payloads. keep it neutral.

anita: draft: "We're investigating a small number of embedding request failures. If you see errors, please share a sanitized request payload and request id. We're prioritizing affected customers." want to post to #customer-notify?

ben: make it: add timeframe: "We're investigating now; we'll follow up within 2 hours."

anita: updated and queued to #customer-notify with incident tag.

lucy: I'll add a temporary input sanitization patch to edge to drop non-utf8 metadata and return 400 with clear error message. will push canary hotfix behind feature flag in 10m.

omar: good. that's lower blast than full rollback.

maya: decision summary: manual intervened pin to previous version (3.7.0) for 60m, support notified customers, eng to deploy input-sanitization hotfix behind flag. if embed_failure_rate stays >2% or we see more 5xxs from model-serving after hotfix, we will escalate to partial rollback.

ben: also send an update to release notes: append an "ongoing investigation" note and link to INF-3421.

ci-bot: created issue INF-3421 and attached logs — https://issues.redwood.ai/INF-3421

anita: posted customer note to #customer-notify.

lucy: hotfix pushed to canary flag=drop-non-utf8-meta. monitoring metrics now.

maya: leaving this pinned until 1754321805 then re-evaluate (or earlier if metrics clear). thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
